other_conditions: Only native/permanent girls of Uttarakhand are eligible
Maximum two living girls per family can receive benefits
First phase must be applied within 6 months of the girl’s birth
Birth must occur in a government hospital, private hospital, or ANM centre (including hospitals of other states)
A certificate proving native/permanent residency must be attached
A copy of the institutional delivery certificate must be attached
Delivery by a trained midwife is not considered institutional delivery
Second phase application deadline is 30 November each financial year
The bank account provided must be active
A joint bank account must be opened with the mother, or father if the mother is deceased, or the guardian if both parents are deceased, and it must be linked to the beneficiary’s Aadhaar
An income certificate issued by the Tehsildar (showing family annual income up to Rs 72,000) is required
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs 62,000 per girl (Rs 11,000 at birth and Rs 51,000 after Class 12) transferred to a bank account
